_comment: Deterministic prompt/query fixtures for the real-model harness (issue #58 bullet 3). Each targets a FIXTURE_DBS schema already committed at tests/fixtures/schemas/<db_id>.json, so the L2 lane reuses the exact same schema contract the hermetic L2 suite verifies. `gold_pure_text` is the intended arm-C `Class.all()` query a human would write for `question` — the reference the faithfulness metric (return-type equivalence) compares constrained model output against, per docs/spec/testing.md and store_grammar.rs's existing arm-C precedent (`every_fixture_class_all_lambda_compiles_against_its_own_pmcd`).
